title: System Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior System Engineer III to join our Enterprise Monitoring team. In this role, you will be critical to the daily operations, maintenance, and optimization of our observability platforms— Splunk, DynaTrace, and NewRelic —and will also support day-to-day ticketing and incident response workflows. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver with a passion for automation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the daily health, performance, and availability of enterprise monitoring tools (Splunk, DynaTrace, NewRelic).
  • Perform routine maintenance, upgrades, and configuration tuning to ensure optimal system performance.
  • Triage and resolve monitoring-related incidents and service tickets in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to integrate monitoring solutions and improve visibility.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and reports to support operational and business needs.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and support incident response efforts.
  • Document operational procedures, runbooks, and knowledge base articles.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in systems engineering or enterprise monitoring roles.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk, DynaTrace, and NewRelic in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of IT operations, incident management, and ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automation and tool integration.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerized environments (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and a bias for action in high-pressure situations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Portuguese is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in a global or distributed team.
  • Knowledge of ITIL practices and observability maturity models.
  • Certifications in Splunk, DynaTrace, or NewRelic are a plus.

Você separa e combina tarefas em fluxos de trabalho eficientes e simples. Você é decisivo(a) e toma decisões de alta qualidade, mesmo com informações incompletas ou diante da incerteza. Você demonstra uma enorme iniciativa em situações difíceis e é excepcional em identificar e aproveitar oportunidades.

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. title: Supervisor de Produção
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO

Em modalidade de turno: Responsável pela gestão e atividades relacionadas ao processo produtivo na planta em que atua, supervisionando todas as etapas, provendo recursos e monitorando as necessidades de manutenções, sejam preventivas ou corretivas, atendendo os requisitos de qualidade e concentrando o time em temas e rotinas de segurança. Suportar e prover recursos para a equipe de forma a garantir a eficiência da operação e o atingimento dos resultados operacionais, bem como difundir rotinas de gestão da área cascateadas ao nível de turno como Manutenção Autônoma, requisitos do AMPS (Ardagh Metal Production System) e demais requisitos e acordos repassados pela gerência imediata ou corporação.

Em modalidade administrativa: Responsável pela gestão e atividades da área produtiva, supervisionando processos, rotinas e cumprimentos de padrões, servindo de ponto focal e de apoio ao gerente de produção na propagação de conhecimentos, recursos, desenvolvimentos e monitoramentos necessários para execução das rotinas da área. Suporta também o Gerente de Produção em rotinas administrativas da área como reuniões de planejamentos, demandas corporativas, estratégias de melhoria de resultados e sistema de gestão (AMPS).

RESPONSABILIDADES

Em modalidade de turno:

  • Conhecer, proceder e assegurar que as Políticas da Empresa, no que diz respeito a preservação do meio ambiente, prevenção na gestão de riscos e normas de saúde e segurança do trabalho; qualidade do produto; segurança de alimentos (FSSC 22.000); código de ética; compliance; recursos humanos; missão, visão e valores da empresa, buscando o alinhamento da conduta à estratégia/objetivos estabelecidos da Empresa e garantir que sejam cumpridos pela equipe.
  • Atuar conforme os procedimentos vigentes relacionados a gestão de mudança sendo responsável pelo reporte, divulgação, plano de ação e comunicação junto a equipe.
  • Supervisionar e prover recursos para a execução das rotinas da operação, por meio do monitoramento das manutenções preventivas e corretivas dos equipamentos, controle do volume de produção e tipo de rótulo a ser produzido.
  • Realizar a abertura e fechamento das Ordens de Produção, de Manutenção e consumos de materiais necessários para organização das rotinas produtivas.
  • Tomar decisões relacionadas ao processo produtivo, baseadas em análise de dados técnicos e estatísticos para garantir a assertividade da decisão.
  • Direcionar as ações para minimizar as perdas no processo produtivo, aumentar a eficiência operacional e controlar o consumo de insumos.
  • Garantir a execução dos planos de ação e diretrizes da área na busca do atingimento das metas e resultados operacionais.
  • Supervisionar as atividades de retrabalho de produtos fora de especificação de modo adequá-los ao padrão de qualidade, bem como em processos de repacking.
  • Facilitar a comunicação e disseminação das informações corporativas entre a equipe.
  • Desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe de acordo com a matriz de competência avaliando as necessidades individuais de treinamento e atendendo aos prazos definidos pela corporação.
  • Realizar a avaliação de desempenho da equipe, dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, mapeamento as forças e oportunidades de cada colaborador para elaboração do plano de desenvolvimento individual e retenção de talentos.
  • Realizar feedbacks, promovendo o desenvolvimento de cada colaborador em alinhamento às estratégias e valores da empresa.
  • Executar atividades técnicas e administrativas ligadas a gestão de pessoas, tais como: recrutamento e seleção, integração de novos colaboradores, plano e controle de execução dos treinamentos, ajuste do ponto eletrônico, planejamento de férias, medidas disciplinares e desligamento.
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável para o engajamento da equipe e melhores resultados.
  • Praticar o conceito de “Melhoria Contínua” no processo, implementando melhorias de segurança e qualidade, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir as práticas de housekeeping.
  • Atuar no AMPS (Ardagh Metal Production System) liderando equipes e grupos internos em todas as iniciativas necessárias conformes demandas da gerência imediata ou corporativa.
  • Comunicar a gerência imediata qualquer problema que ocorra no processo produtivo, bem como seguir o fluxo de comunicação definido na planta para envolvimento de outras áreas, quando necessário e aplicável.
  • Comunicar, treinar, acompanhar e tratar quaisquer questões de segurança do time e da área, a fim de preservar integridade física dos colaboradores e aderência do time operacional à cultura e iniciativas na área de EHS.
  • Disponibilizar e gerenciar recursos como gestões visuais, ferramentas e outros juntamente com o time operacional afim de garantir que se mantenha disponibilizado e em bom estado de conservação todos os recursos disponibilizados para correta execução das atividades.
  • Analisar e montar plano estratégico em caso de desvios de resultados de produção, qualidade, segurança e manutenção, apresentando em reuniões solicitadas e acompanhando o ciclo para garantir correto cumprimento de ações estabelecidadas, por si ou por outros.

Em modalidade administrativa, além de saber realizar e monitorar os mencionados acima para turno, deve:

  • Monitorar o plano de produção, a fim de conciliar as demandas corporativas para atendimento ao cliente com as necessidades locais da planta, montando estratégias de atendimento por módulo e por tipos de produto.
  • Realizar gestões de rotinas, criando e acompanhando indicadores a fim de suportar a execução das rotinas operacionais pelos times operacionais de turno de maneira correta, conforme padrões estabelecidos para cada atividade.
  • Suportar o gerente de produção, por sua solicitação ou ausência, em rotinas administrativas como reuniões corporativas e locais, demandas pontuais ou rotineiras, seja nos temas de segurança, qualidade, produção, manutenção, rh, bem como qualquer outro tema definido que alinhe a área aos requisitos definidos pela organização.
  • Realizar a gestão de KPIs da área já definidos pela companhia visando atingimento de metas e resultados.
  • Ser um facilitador de informações e conhecimento na área, treinando ou suportando os supervisores de turno envolvendo a todos nos temas necessários para a área produtiva.
  • Realizar trabalhos/análises estratégicas para a área, de forma mais abrangente e sistêmica comparando ao supervisor de turno, visando melhoria de resultados e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Auxiliar o Gerente de Produção na condução da Manutenção Autônoma na área produtiva.
  • Participar da implementação de Trials da área, quando solicitado, e repassar informações e direcionamentos aos turnos.
  • Liderar projetos na área produtiva, sejam esses definidos pela gerência local ou corporativa. Ex.: Plant of the Future (PoF).
  • Garantir que as rotinas de reuniões da área produtiva ocorram com o envolvimento correto das pessoas necessárias para boa condução e atingimento dos objetivos.

Formação

Superior completo

Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

  • Pacote Office;
  • Liderança de Equipes (com experiência prévia);
  • Análise e Interpretação de Dados;
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de performance (Produção e Manutenção);
  • Conhecimento e habilidade com processos produtivos;
  • Conhecimento em auditorias e processos de certificações;
  • Habilidade de interpretação e consulta dos manuais técnicos dos equipamentos.
  • Sistemas ERP: SAP;
  • Lean Manufacturing / TPM / WCM ou correlatos;
  • Conhecimento em processos de Estampagem / Corte e repuxo (Prensas);
  • Idioma: Inglês Intermediário ou Avançado.

Sobre a Ardagh:

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!

Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.

Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)

Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.

API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.

Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.

Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

o Use SQL for end-of-day report generation, STP (straight through processing) failure issues, P&L evaluation, for analyzing issues in trade feed and status Etc.

o Create shell/python scripts for automation of day-to-day manual activities.

Understand requirements, analyze the problem areas of the current system and behavior of pre- trade and post-trade workflow, and integration points.

title: Gerente de projetos de inovação
description:
A Savoy, pertencente ao Grupo Coty no Brasil, é uma empresa voltada a desempenhar atividades de fabricação e industrialização de cosméticos, produtos de perfumaria e higiene pessoal para o mercado brasileiro e exportação para América Latina.

O Grupo Coty é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do mundo, com um portfólio icônico de marcas de fragrâncias, cosméticos, cuidados com a pele e corpo. No Grupo Coty, celebramos e cultivamos uma cultura de gentileza. Portanto, temos orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais.

No Grupo Coty, acreditamos que a beleza reside na diversidade e estamos empenhados em continuar a construir um ambiente onde todos os talentos brilhem, pois valorizamos as contribuições únicas que cada indivíduo traz para a nossa equipe. E como parte do nosso compromisso com a inclusão, todos os perfis são bem-vindos.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Coordenar e supervisionar as atividades de desenvolvimento de projetos, de acordo com Plano de Investimento / Equipamentos / Obras, envolvendo todas as fases do processo, utilizando recursos próprios e / ou de terceiros; Acompanhar através de indicadores o desempenho da equipe, qualidade dos serviços e produtividade, bem como cumprimento das normas de BPF, POP, segurança, higiene e limpeza;
  • Coordenar as atividades de desenvolvimento de projetos de aquisição de máquinas/equipamentos, construção e/ou ampliação das instalações das unidades fabris, de acordo com Plano de Investimentos/Equipamentos/Obras, envolvendo todas as fases (projeto conceitual, levantamento de custos, interferências, viabilidade de execução, avaliações diversas, elaboração do projeto estrutural, memorial descritivo para apresentação de proposta, equalização técnica das propostas para atender o escopo do serviço, etc.), utilizando recursos próprios e/ou de terceiros, orientando sua equipe, visando atender as necessidades das empresas do grupo;
  • Garantir a execução dos projetos, mediante o cumprimento do cronograma definido, processo licitatório/tomada de preços, controlando atividades tomadas junto a terceiros, visando que os serviços contratados sejam realizados dentro das normas, qualidade, custos e prazos estabelecidos, bem como avaliar os resultados ao longo do processo;
  • Interagir com a área de Suprimentos, dando suporte técnico, solicitando propostas consolidadas para avaliação, requisitando a compra de equipamentos se necessário, bem como a elaboração de contratos de fornecimentos e/ou de Prestação de Serviços pela área Jurídica;
  • Desenvolver, qualificar e acompanhar novos fornecedores junto ao Suprimentos, mediante apoio técnico nas negociações para aquisição de serviços e produtos, e acompanhar negociações junto a fornecedores de serviços/equipamentos relacionados a sua área.
  • Apoiar a gerência na elaboração do orçamento, através do levantamento de informações necessárias, bem como acompanhar despesas da área, comparando real e realizados.
  • Apoiar a gerência em busca de novas tecnologias e processos que garantam maior eficiência, maior qualidade e menor custo produtivo;
  • Coordenar as instalações e/ou montagem de máquinas e equipamentos de produção, interligações de utilidades e de sistemas de controle e comando, testes para entrar em produção, visando garantir a obtenção dos limites de performance dos equipamentos adquiridos;
  • Acompanhar desempenho funcional de trabalho e desenvolver equipe de engenharia, avaliando comportamento e motivação, bem como identificar necessidades de treinamento, buscando aprimorar o desempenho;
  • Apoiar área de manutenção industrial em busca de melhorias de equipamentos, processos e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas internas, de engenharia, Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão e de segurança e higiene no trabalho, bem como as normas de boas práticas de fabricação, atuar como auditor interno da Qualidade, garantindo a aplicação dos procedimentos do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, bem como suportar a área de produção em casos emergenciais.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Civil, Elétrica, Mecânica, Mecatrônica ou Produção;
  • Desejado: Pós-graduação na área de gestão de projetos;

description:
Security Manager

Location: Americas, Remote

About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.

Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise-grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast-moving development environments.

What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company-wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization-wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company-wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.

Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud-native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI/CD pipelines — automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure-by-design implementation in infrastructure-as-code and deployments.

Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi-region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.

Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in written and spoken English

We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Safety, Environment & Healthy Coordinator
description:
Somos PepsiCo

Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados(as) com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.

Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER®, TODDY®, TODDYNHO®, ELMA CHIPS®, RUFFLES®, DORITOS®, EQLIBRI ™, GATORADE®, KERO COCO®, H2OH!®, PEPSI® e muitas outras.

Uma carreira na PepsiCo significa trabalhar em uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Aqui, você pode ousar ser você. Não importa quem você seja, de onde você venha ou quem você ame, você sempre pode influenciar as pessoas ao seu redor e causar um impacto positivo no mundo.

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs

A oportunidade

Garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro e saudável para todos os colaboradores da planta de Feira de Santana (locais administrativos, Manufatura, Warehouse e etc.), atendendo a conformidade com todas as regulamentações ambientais e de saúde e segurança relacionadas à unidade, incluindo a implementação de políticas, procedimentos e sistema de gestão interno que visam prevenir acidentes, lesões ocupacionais e impactos ambientais.

Garantir o cumprimento dos objetivos, metas e indicadores definidos pela Pepsico e definir estratégias de atuação para a área e desenvolvimento da equipe.

O seu impacto

- Garantir o cumprimento da Política de Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança (SSMA) estabelecida;

- Liderar a equipe local de EHS;

- Garantir o cumprimento das normas locais, estaduais e federais de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente;

- Desenvolver e implementar programas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente;

- Identificar e avaliar os riscos associados às operações da planta e do armazém, incluindo análises de risco de processo;

- Fornecer suporte e treinamento relacionados a EHS;

- Investigar incidentes de segurança, acidentes de trabalho e eventos ambientais para determinar as causas e implementar medidas de controle;

- Liderar a implementação e manutenção do sistema de gestão interno na fábrica;

- Gerenciar riscos e minimizar impactos relacionados às atividades, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e novas tecnologias e compartilhar as melhores práticas;

- Liderar inspeções e acompanhar visitas técnicas, inspeções e auditorias de órgãos públicos;

- Recomendar medidas de controle quanto ao grau de exposição a agentes agressivos de natureza física, química e biológica, caracterizando atividades, operações e locais insalubres e perigosos;

- Analisar e liderar a gestão de mudanças para instalações, máquinas, equipamentos e projetos da área de Engenharia;

- Especificar, controlar e supervisionar, garantindo a qualidade e a eficiência dos sistemas de proteção coletiva e Equipamentos de Segurança, incluindo equipamentos de proteção individual e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio;

- Interagir ativamente junto aos Comitês Técnicos, principalmente liderando os programas sistêmicos visando a garantia das execuções;

- Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia durante o planejamento e execução de projetos de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente;

- Governar e gerenciar os indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) de EHS, criar planos para melhoria contínua e conformidade;

- Gerenciar o orçamento e o planejamento estratégico da área (Budget);

- Gestão do AOP (Annual Operating Plan);

- Desenvolver e apresentar os resultados de EHS à liderança e à operação;

- Implementar práticas e tecnologias sustentáveis para minimizar o impacto ambiental da operação da planta;

- Gerenciar o licenciamento da planta;

- Colaborar com outras áreas, como produção, manutenção e qualidade, para garantir a integração efetiva das práticas de EHS em todas as atividades;

- Conduzir campanhas, comunicações e programas de conscientização de EHS;

- Manter contato com agências reguladoras e acompanhar atividades de inspeção e fiscalização.

Quem estamos buscando?

  • Graduação em Engenharia com especialização em Engenharia de Segurança e Meio Ambiente;
  • Experiência sólida como líder em Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança (SSMA);
  • Sólido conhecimento do sistema de gestão de SSMA;
  • Auditor líder em ISO 14001, ISO 45001 e suas aplicabilidades;
  • Sólido conhecimento das regulamentações atuais de SSMA;
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de talentos;
  • Habilidade desenvolvida em gerenciar dados e estatísticas de SSMA;
  • Habilidades eficazes de networking em uma região multinacional, multifuncional e com múltiplas unidades de negócios;
  • Idiomas: Inglês (experiente), Espanhol (experiente) desejável.
  • Expertise em plataformas de gestão de Requisitos Legais (ex. Sistema IUS Natura);
  • Auditor líder em sistemas de gestão de EHS;

Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção; ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).

Principais Atividades / Responsabilidades:

Elaborar e executar o plano de negócios, garantindo o cumprimento do objetivo de vendas da companhia.

  • Fazer a gestão das contas dos canais direto e indireto.
  • Fazer a gestão dos pedidos, inserção no sistema, acompanhamento diário da carteira de pedidos conferindo seus status no sistema após o seu faturamento para evitar devoluções ou falta de itens na digitação.
  • Acompanhar o faturamento e monitorar a entrega dos pedidos através do agendamento das entregas feito em conjunto com time de faturamento (supply chain), bem como posicionar as compradoras (es) sobre qualquer situação inerente aos pedidos quando necessário.
  • Intermediar e equilibrar as necessidades dos clientes com as da MAM. Promover uma relação harmoniosa e eficaz.
  • Explorar o potencial de cada cliente (aumento de lojas com produtos MAM, encartes, e-commerce).
  • Desenvolver ações e campanhas de vendas com o objetivo de aumentar o volume de venda nos clientes.
  • Elaborar análises do sell in vs sell out em excel para acompanhamento e ações corretivas.
  • Apresentar semanalmente ou a cada reunião de ciclo os planos de desenvolvimento/investimento das contas para ao gestor de vendas.
  • Manter o gestor de vendas informado sobre ações (via fone, e-mail, reuniões agendadas). Se necessário marcar uma reunião individual, desenvolver KPI`s para apresentações ao gestor de Vendas.
  • Negociar e controlar verbas, contratos e provisões.
  • Agendar e conduzir reuniões de business review com os gestores comerciais e de trade das redes diretas bem os gestores e equipe de vendas dos distribuidores, acompanhado ou não do gestor de vendas MAM.
  • Treinar e Capacitar comercialmente as equipes de vendas dos distribuidores para que estes multipliquem os treinamentos no PDV.
  • Gerir de forma constante os pilares do canal distribuidor (Distribuição, Sortimento e Execução). Buscando fomentar de forma exponencial o crescimento em distribuição (aumento da positivação e base de clientes na área de atuação no canal independente).
  • Analisar e monitorar os KPIs de vendas do canal indireto (sell out, positivação, efetividade de rotas/vendedores do distribuidor).
  • Trabalho direcionado com prévia confecção de agenda para rota em campo com os vendedores do distribuidor e visita as principais redes da base do distribuidor.

Construir relacionamento de longo prazo nos clientes, através de visitas frequentes e apresentações diferenciadas.

  • Agendar visitas nas lojas ou matrizes para apresentação das ações feitas.
  • Estreitar relacionamento com os decisores de compra.
  • Divulgar lançamentos e seus benefícios.
  • Desenvolver em Power point de forma objetiva o cenário de cada cliente para apresentação (vendas, evolução, mix de produtos, pesquisa de preços) com o objetivo de receber o feedback das compradoras (es) no intuito de aprimorar as ações.
  • Dar sugestões para as compradoras (es).
  • Mostrar ações desenvolvidas pela empresa as compradoras (es).
  • Manter relacionamento saudável e diálogo aberto com toda base de clientes.

Desenvolver estratégias, visando Sell Out e a ampliação do mix de produtos.

  • Desenvolver e implementar o calendário promocional nos principais clientes diretos e indiretos.
  • Atualizar e levar sugestões de produtos (atuais e novos), apresentando o benefício de cada produto.
  • Através da análise do Sell In e Sell Out propor um alinhamento de mix, quando necessário.
  • Fazer a análise de itens por lojas/região para ajustes de unidade x item.
  • Elaborar e monitorar ativações no PDV em conjunto com o trade marketing da MAM e do cliente.

Acompanhar a execução dos produtos no PDV.

  • Ministrar treinamentos aos atendentes de lojas, além da comunicação das ações promocionais nos clientes (encartes, ponto extra).
  • Estreitar relacionamento com os gerentes, encarregados e repositores.
  • Assegurar a presença adequada dos produtos no PDV nos canais direto e indireto através da implementação dos KPI´s de Sortimento, Exposição, Planograma e Preço.
  • Garantir o Preço Sugerido no PDV (preço público MAM).
  • Fazer visitas constantes em todas as regiões onde temos lojas e promotoras, elaborando um relatório para o promotor(a) da área para efetuar as melhorias se necessárias.
  • Manter comunicação constante com o coordenador de merchandising relatando situações de PDV bem como da performance geral dos promotores sob gestão do coordenador de merchandising.

Manter o gestor de vendas Informado (via e-mail, telefone, reuniões).

Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Rio de Janeiro, Espirito Santo e Santa Cataria.

Refer is an exclusive AI-powered career agent that connects top talent from Stanford, MIT, Harvard, and other top 20 US universities to leading tech companies like NVIDIA, Meta, Glean, DeepMind, Scale AI, and 1,000+ startups.

We are expanding rapidly and launching a Refer & Earn program so more people can help us grow this elite talent community — and get rewarded for it.

✨ About the Role

We’re looking for Sales Representatives who want a flexible, remote opportunity to help talented people find great jobs — and get paid extremely well for it.

This is not a typical “marketing” or “recruiting” job.

Your role is simple:

Share Refer with people who qualify

When they join and get accepted — you earn

If they get hired — you earn big

That's it.

Compensation (Commission Only)

You earn:

  • $50 for every qualified user you bring who signs up
  • $1,000 if they get hired or make a hire through Refer

There is no limit to how much you can earn.

Some ambassadors make a few hundred dollars per week.

Some make thousands.

Who Should Apply

This role is perfect for people who:

  • Are active on LinkedIn
  • Have friends from top universities
  • Know people in tech or startups
  • Are involved in online communities
  • Want a flexible side gig with high upside
  • Want to help people find jobs that match their potential

No experience required.

Just bring people to Refer — we do the rest.

Who Qualifies to Be Referred

You’ll have the most success referring people who are:

  • Job seekers with a degree from a top 20 US university , OR
  • Hiring managers / team leads at top tech companies or startups
  • US-based only

You’ll receive more details and tools after joining.

What You’ll Do

As a Sales Representative, you will:

  • Promote Refer
  • Post about Refer in relevant online communities
  • Invite top talent and hiring managers to join
  • Use your unique invitation link to track earnings
  • Help us grow the strongest talent network in the country

We’ll provide:

  • Messaging templates
  • Guidance on where to promote
  • Best practices to maximize your earnings

title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
description:
We are Software Mind, an awesome team of engineers who are ready to ramp up any top-notch company’s projects! Our aim? To always be one step ahead. Become part of a multicultural company in constant growth with an excellent work environment certified by Great Place To Work!

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer to join one of our USA Clients' engineering teams which is building solutions to dramatically change the way people purchase their daily goods, providing the modern-day solution to meet customer’s immediate everyday needs with products ranging from snacks and ice cream to household goods and beer, at the click of a button. If you enjoy working with cutting-edge technologies in a fast-paced environment this opportunity is for you!

Expectations - the experience you need

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science (or related field)
  • 8+ years of experience in a senior engineering role with increasing responsibility, focused on Backend Development & Integrations.
  • Experience acting in a tech lead capacity for a small team without direction.
  • Proficiency with SQL, Postgres, NodeJS, Java, and/or Go.
  • Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and their application in building.
  • Data intensive applications that process high velocity data (millions of transactions) or high-volume data (transactions impacting millions of records).
  • Experience using Terraform, Pulumi, Helm, GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with SQL data analysis (Snowflake/BigQuery), some familiarity of data pipelines.
  • Experience with message-based, async processing.
  • Experience with JavaScript & SPA technology in a production setting (e.g. Vue, React).
  • Public cloud experience in a production setting (Azure preferred).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Responsibilities - What you'll do

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software solutions.
  • Implement system and data monitors to ensure the correctness of the business process.
  • Contribute to multiple team-wide business and tech objectives (beyond just the goals assigned).
  • Lead cross-functional projects in an agile environment; participate in planning, Scope, decompose, and organize projects for multiple teammates.
  • Delegate tasks and coordinate teammates to bring those projects to completion with minimal oversight.
  • Generate time estimates with reasonable accuracy to help determine project timelines.
  • Support standard development practices across your team, including idiomatic syntax, design patterns, and Testing/Quality Practice.
  • Provide primary operational support and engineering for multiple large distributed software applications.
  • Integrate with existing REST APIs, author new APIs, and expose the data to the frontend.

Our offer – professional development, personal growth

  • Educational resources
  • Flexible schedule and work from anywhere
  • Referral Program
  • Supportive and chill atmosphere

We are accepting applications from LATAM countries

title: Business Account Representative
description:
We are looking for a Business Account Representative to play a key role in ensuring the continued success and satisfaction of our rapidly growing customer base.

Your Role

You will contribute to our clients’ success by:

  • Ensuring the satisfaction and retention of your client portfolio.
  • Onboarding suppliers and clients onto our platform to guarantee optimal use of our services.
  • Creating and validating new projects — verifying the correct configuration of supplier and client profiles, validating legal documents, and processing purchase orders.
  • Closely monitoring project renewals and managing purchase order receptions.
  • Maintaining strong alignment and collaboration with Account Managers.
  • Ensuring a seamless billing process through close coordination with the Finance team.
  • Continuously improving our sales administration processes by sharing feedback and ideas that enhance the value we deliver to clients.
  • Providing additional support when needed to meet business objectives.

About You

You are an enthusiastic, detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with people and solving problems.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • Strong interpersonal skills and a positive, proactive attitude.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English .
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Customer Support, Account Management, or a related service field (preferably within digital products).
  • A degree in Communication, Management, IT, Business , or a similar field.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to manage complexity and pay close attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.

What we offer

  • An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities
  • An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities
  • A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250+ available modules
  • A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.)
  • Strong commitments to CSR notably through participation in our WeCare Together program

Our Hiring Process

  • Short phone call with our talent acquisition team to discuss about your ambitions and how they align with Mantu's mission.
  • First interview with your future manager or director. In this interview you will know more about your role, your mission, the challenges, and the skills we value.
  • Second interview with a senior leader or your future teammates. This is the time to share what you've discovered about us and how thrilled you are to join us and how well we fit with your expectation.
  • Third with the department director. If we are a perfect match, this interview might just end with a job offer.

title: Oracle Cloud Field Service consultant
description:
Job Specification: Oracle Cloud Field Service Consultant

Contract Role – Remote

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud Field Service (OFS) Consultant to support the design, configuration, optimization, and ongoing enhancement of our field service operations. This is a remote contract role suited for someone with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Field Service Cloud, with additional experience in Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC) and Oracle CPQ being highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and customization of Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) to support business workflows, scheduling, routing, and mobile field operations.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable functional and technical solutions.
  • Configure OFS modules including capacity, activity management, work order orchestration, routing plans, and mobility experiences.
  • Integrate OFS with other Oracle cloud applications, especially Oracle Service Cloud , Oracle CPQ , and external systems via REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform solution testing, UAT support, documentation, and knowledge transfer to internal teams.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring seamless field operations.
  • Recommend best practices and continuous improvements in field service processes.
  • Support deployment activities, including data migration, configuration promotion, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including service operations, IT, product management, and vendors.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) .
  • Strong understanding of OFS architecture, configuration frameworks, APIs, message scenarios, routing, and capacity planning.
  • Experience designing workflows, activity types, and policy configurations in OFS.
  • Ability to write and interpret OFS API integrations, business rules, and extensibility scripts.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements and convert them into actionable configuration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery environments.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Desired Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Oracle Service Cloud (RightNow/OSvC) configuration, workflows, and integrations.
  • Experience with Oracle CPQ (quoting workflows, commerce rules, integrations).
  • Understanding of broader Oracle CX Cloud architecture and integrations.
  • Experience with mobile workforce or field service applications outside Oracle.
  • Knowledge of cloud integration tools (OIC, Boomi, MuleSoft, etc.).

title: Product Designer
description:
About the Company

Hi, we’re Actabl. We’re providing better solutions for hotel companies as the world around us evolves and changes related to using technology, finding labor, and maximizing profits. Our mission is to empower the people that power hospitality. We give hoteliers actionable insights to know what to do, the tools to do it, and the visibility to know it worked. We bring together powerful hospitality tech solutions to maximize profits for more than 10,000 properties in hospitality markets around the world.

Our Valued Behaviors

  • Start with People: We are in the hospitality business and hospitality starts with people. This impacts both our being and our doing.
  • Being: We are responsible for building relationships, earning trust, and having fun. These things are fundamental to hospitality.
  • Doing: We will succeed if we start with great people working as one team. Empower others, speak the truth with care, and go together.
  • Demand Integrity: Be trustworthy, be ethical, and be consistent whether someone is watching or not. Demand integrity of yourself and others to build the fabric of a high-integrity organization.
  • Delight the Customer: We aim to delight our customers in the same way our customers aim to delight their guests. The question is not if completed a process or hit a metric, the question is whether or not the customer is delighted.
  • Champion Innovation: We compete in the game of change and win through innovation. Think big and then think bigger when it comes to the innovation required to tackle the problems our customers face daily.
  • Make it Happen: We show up prepared, care about the details, and follow through. Don't get distracted. Don't stop at blockers. Don't make excuses. Find a way and drive until it is done.

About Actabl's Product Design Team

We redefine expectations

We treat SaaS with the same passion and craft you’d expect from world-class consumer products. Our mission is to redefine what hospitality teams can expect from their tools by delivering thoughtful, high-quality experiences and pushing the product forward step by step, with real impact.

Bellhop Design System

Our young design system is called Bellhop because it was inspired by the essence of hospitality. It's a scalable and cohesive system made to empower people who power hospitality. Check out .

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end design across features and flows, from discovery to delivery.
  • Collaborate with PMs and engineers to shape problem spaces, define requirements, and validate solutions.
  • Design intuitive, scalable interfaces for enterprise SaaS products with heavy use of dashboards, complex data tables, and operational workflows .
  • Run user interviews, synthesize insights, and convert them into actionable design decisions.
  • Produce high-quality UI/UX deliverables: journeys, wireframes, flows, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, tables, dashboards, etc.
  • Work closely with our design system team to maintain consistency and push our standards forward.
  • Advocate for user experience and influence decision-making across cross-functional teams.
  • Incorporate AI tools, Vibe Coding, and rapid prototyping into your process to increase velocity and quality.
  • Understand our products, personas, their journeys, and JTBD.

You as a Product Designer

Ideal Profile

You are not a “by the books” Product Designer and have at least 3 years of experience, strong design craft, and excellent communication skills. You are comfortable with high-density enterprise SaaS interfaces such as dashboards and data grids, and you work confidently with design systems and cross-functional teams.

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer (UX/UI) in tech or SaaS companies.
  • Portuguese and English is mandatory
  • Living in Brazil.
  • Strong product thinking, ability to break down complexity, understand constraints, frame problems, and propose pragmatic solutions.
  • Excellent English communication (major stakeholders are native english speakers)
  • Solid experience designing for enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Comfortable crafting elegant high-density interfaces.
  • Experience working with design systems (tokens, components, libraries).
  • Strong craft with an attention to detail.
  • Portfolio demonstrating clear thinking, strong fundamentals, and high-quality craft.'

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI prototyping tools (e.g., Figma Make, V0, Claude Code).
  • Experience integrating AI into design workflows.
  • Familiarity with hospitality, operational tools, or B2B workflows.

Work Environment:

Location: Full-remote Brasil.

Connectivity: Requires a reliable internet connection and a suitable home office setup.

Equipment: The company provides necessary equipment (laptop, monitor, peripherals).

Travel: Occasional travel may be required. A valid driver's license may be required for travel.

Work Hours: Employees are expected to be available during core business hours to ensure collaboration with team members and stakeholders.

Communication: Regular communication via video calls, chat applications, and email is expected.

Additional Information

  • Full-remote job position
  • You will be hired as a contractor (PJ)

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are looking for a high-performing Full Stack Engineer with strong experience in both Python (backend) and React (frontend) to join our client’s distributed engineering team in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone who excels at building clean, scalable APIs and intuitive user interfaces while collaborating with product, design, and engineering stakeholders.

You will be responsible for developing end-to-end features, improving system architecture, and supporting the evolution of a modern tech stack powering mission-critical applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Python (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • Develop responsive, user-friendly front-end applications using React, Typescript, and modern UI frameworks.
  • Implement RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs and integrate them with internal and external systems.
  • Work closely with product managers and UX/UI designers to translate requirements into high-quality code.
  • Optimize performance across front-end and back-end components.
  • Manage databases and data models (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Contribute to overall system architecture, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
  • Write automated tests (unit, integration, end-to-end) to maintain code quality.
  • Collaborate in an agile environment with remote teams across Brazil.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–7+ years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer or Software Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python and popular backend frameworks (FastAPI preferred, Flask, Django).
  • Professional experience with React and Typescript (Hooks, Context, Redux, or similar).
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs or GraphQL services.
  • Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Experience deploying applications using cloud services ( AWS, GCP, or Azure ).
  • Solid grasp of software architecture, design patterns, and version control (Git).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment with clear communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized deployments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
  • Exposure to microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with testing frameworks (PyTest, Jest, Cypress, etc.).
  • Experience working with Brazilian or international distributed engineering teams.

title: Data Research Analyst
description:
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 3-5 years of data analysis and reporting experience
  • Advanced experience writing and creating large-scale surveys (QuestionPro, Qualtrics), analyzing results/data, and developing actionable findings
  • Experience with Tableau for data visualization
  • Experience in writing detailed reports and presenting data findings/analysis.

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Passion for video games/gaming in order to assist in writing and interpreting survey questions
  • Experience with SQL writing data queries
  • Snowflake or Data Bricks experience

Insight Global is hiring a Data Research Analyst to support the User Experience Research team at a leading company in the Gaming industry. The main role of the Data Research Analyst will be to create, send, and analyze large-scale surveys intended to learn about the player base of the core gaming products.

Job Functions

-Create surveys and trackers to support all products and initiatives

  • Design questions that do not bias respondents
  • Use best practice methodologies to produce actionable, accurate, and representative data.

-Advanced, survey focused, data visualizations (Tableau, Excel, Sheets)

  • Creating clear reports and dashboards based on surveys sent to players and users of their products.

-Data queries (HIVE, Snowflake, Tableau)

  • Querying multiple types of databases and plugging data queries directly into tools like Tableau are essential for this role. These skills will be used to target audiences for survey sends, pull in additional analytics to identify respondents, and allow for advanced data visualizations.

-Report writing and presenting data

  • Writing detailed and understandable reports that will speak to a variety of audiences across the enterprise
  • Presenting data in meetings and providing additional relevant context where applicable.

-Act as backup for all functions of current data researchers

-Provide support to UX researchers on report creation that involves data visualization.

-Quickly pivot with new data to ensure a constant flow of player insights are output as updated player survey data is received to ensure we are always reporting on timely and relevant findings.

-Contribute to overall needs of the UXR team e.g. peer review, supporting other teams with survey expertise, etc.

-Contribute survey expertise to assist others in the company with the creation of surveys.

title: Coordenador fiscal - Torre de faturamento
description:
Briefing da posição:

Como Coordenador/Supervisor Fiscal da Torre de Faturamento, o profissional será responsável por liderar a operação fiscal vinculada ao faturamento da empresa (“torre” de faturamento), assegurando o correto processamento de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos, cumprimento de obrigações acessórias, e a entrega de resultados por meio de KPIs.

Espera-se perfil de liderança, domínio técnico e capacidade de interface executiva (internamente com Financeiro, Faturamento, Contabilidade, Comercial, e externamente com clientes). O inglês avançado será requisito para interação com equipes globais ou clientes internacionais.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar as atividades da torre de faturamento: emissão e conferência de notas fiscais (saídas/entradas), conferência de faturamento, retenções, XML, NFS-e/NF-e, CTe, etc.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de obrigações acessórias: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, DCTF, EFD-Contribuições, REINF, ECF/ECD, etc;
  • Implantar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da operação fiscal/faturamento (por exemplo: % de notas com erro fiscal, tempo de processamento, custo por nota, índice de credits fiscais aproveitados, SLA de faturamento, conformidade) e reportar à liderança executiva;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a equipe da torre (coordenados e analistas), promovendo treinamento, engajamento, definição de metas, monitoramento de performance e melhorias contínuas de processo;
  • Interface com Financeiro, Contabilidade, Comercial/Vendas, TI/ERP e auditoria, assegurando que as operações de faturamento estejam alinhadas aos controles internos, aos requisitos de compliance e às estratégias de negócio;
  • Liderar ou participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação, mapeamento de riscos fiscais, aproveitamento de créditos, e adaptação a mudanças da legislação (como reforma tributária, por exemplo) ou cenários de negócio;
  • Apresentar análises gerenciais e relatórios executivos (em inglês, quando for o caso) à alta direção ou matriz, com propostas de ação, acompanhamento de metas e suportes decisórios.

Qualificações & requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Preferencialmente com registro CRC ativo (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência sólida em operação fiscal/tributária, com apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos em ambiente corporativo;
  • Experiência comprovada em faturamento ou faturamento tributário (emissão de notas fiscais, retenções, faturamento em operação com produtos/serviços) e liderança de equipe;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) – para reportes, interface com clientes estrangeiros;
  • Perfil forte de liderança, com habilidades executivas — comunicação clara, capacidade de influenciar, visibilidade junto à diretoria, visão de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com KPIs, dashboards, relatórios gerenciais, e métricas de performance da área fiscal/faturamento;
  • Atuação em ambiente de alta demanda, com foco em prazos, entregas, auditorias e mudanças regulatórias;

Competências comportamentais:

  • Visão estratégica com mindset operacional (“hands-on”);
  • Alta capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Orientação para resultados e melhoria contínua;
  • Excelente comunicação (com a equipe, stakeholders e diretoria);
  • Adaptabilidade e proatividade para lidar com mudanças rápidas (ex: reforma tributária, nova legislação);
  • Integridade, postura ética e foco em compliance;

Se você é um líder fiscal com visão estratégica, domínio técnico e capacidade de transformar operações através de performance, governança e indicadores, esta posição pode ser a oportunidade ideal para direcionar resultados com impacto direto no negócio.

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant

Remote – Brazil

*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.

Company Overview

Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.

Position Overview

As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  2. Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  3. Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  4. Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  5. Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  6. Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  7. Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  8. Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  9. Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.

Qualifications

  1. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  2. Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  3. Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  4. Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  5. Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  6. Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.

Preferred Experience

  1. 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  2. Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  3. Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  4. Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  5. Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  6. Strong English Skills.

Benefits:

  1. Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  2. Flexible work environment.
  3. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Coordenador(a) de Recursos Humanos

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos.   • Atuar como braço estendido da presidência em iniciativas corporativas de alto impacto, com capacidade de articulação e influência junto a stakeholders internos e externos;

title: Cabotage Coordinator
description:
Cabotage Coordinator

Job Title: Cabotage Coordinator

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Terms: Full Time. On site.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience, the individual’s, and the team’s performance.

Company:

Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, South Africa, Australia, Brazil, USA, Germany, and continues to be a globally expanding group.

Our Core Business:

  • Global Dry Bulk Freight
  • Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation

For more information, you may check our website：

Role

Sky Fusion is seeking the right candidate to fill a key role, the new Cabotage Coordinator. The primary focus of this role is the coordination of bids for Brazilian Flag impelled cargo opportunities. These are cargoes that will move within the Brazilian territory.

The coordinator will be tasked with evaluating and pursuing both commercial and operational cargoes for carriage on the Company’s Brazil Flag vessels. The scope of these cargo bids may often require extension of the scope to include use of multimodal forms of conveyance.

Candidates are encouraged to think outside of the box. There are always new challenges on the horizon and ways to improve, even in a business as old as shipping.

This position will challenge the coordinator to come up with creative solutions by matching multiple fleet schedules and modes of transportation with various bids. This role will require constant interaction and communication with the Client’s team to ensure the successful execution of projects.

Responsibilities & Duties

a. Identification and pursuit of chartering opportunities for wind projects.

b. Voyage calculations and pricing of both near‐term and long‐term project cargoes.

c. Analysis of intermodal bids (commercial).

d. Administration of quoting system. Emphasis on visibility within team and timely communications with

customers.

e. Project monitoring

f. Tracking Wind Cargo Flows (Historic & Projected)

Requirements & Skills

a. Ability to multi‐task

b. Understanding of terms and conditions for contracts of carriage and carriage of breakbulk cargoes under Brazilian Cabotage legistlation.

c. Strong verbal and written communication skills

d. Attention to detail.

e. Minimum of bachelor’s degree (preferably in a Maritime Business Administration or Transportation).

f. Minimum three (3) years of experience in the Fluvial / Caoastal cabotage transportation industry is preferred but candidates with les experience will still receive consideration.

Personal Characteristics

Ambitious | Enthusiastic | Team player

description:
Our Mission At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few! Job Description Your Career The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies. Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio. Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory

  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services

  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals
Additional Information The Team Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients. As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step. Our Commitment We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
